GOTO1 `const hkReal w = a + b;` -> `hkReal w; w = a + b;`: MSVC 2008 x87 drops the float rounding (fstp/fld DWORD) of the assignment before `fst QWORD`; AArch64 has no excess precision (FLT_EVAL_METHOD 0), both spellings round as the exe; the rest is slot / xmm renaming
GOTO2 (a) copy of `const float& a`: one x87 multiply with its operands swapped (`fld x; fld st; fmul m` -> `fld m; fld x; fld st; fmulp st(2)`; IEEE multiply commutes), 3 jumps shifted by 4 bytes
MATH1: two x87 multiplies with their operands swapped (`fld m; fmul st,st(3)` -> `fld st(2); fmul m`, the same stack value; IEEE multiply commutes); nothing else

with /EHs-c-: one float rounding (fstp/fld DWORD) before a compare dropped after GOTO1 splits (`float radiusSum; radiusSum = ...`), the compare itself the same once its fxch is counted (b <= a or unordered), one fadd commuted, slots renamed; MATH1's <math.h> sqrt(float) is the same (float)sqrt(double) as the decomp's copy; no excess precision on AArch64
with /EHs-c-: two extra fld/fstp DWORD round trips of values that are already float in memory (movss / a float field), exact; jumps shifted
QUAD1: one mulps with its operands swapped through one more register (exact), an alignment `lea ecx,[ecx+0]` dropped; jumps shifted
GOTO2 (c) cloned `result->value = 0; return result;` into each `goto reject`; MSVC merges them again: the same multiset of 779 instructions, blocks in another order

raw bytes (objdump restarts at $LN labels inside instructions): `(float)sqrt((float)x)` now reaches <math.h>'s float sqrt, so the outer cast rounds a float again (one more exact fld/fstp round trip); one fadd commuted, its operand [eax] the same address via an earlier lea
